title: How the Misuse of a Dataset Harmed Semantic Clone Detection
abstract: arXiv:2505.04311v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: BigCloneBench is widely used to evaluate traditional clone detection and, more recently, machine learning approaches to semantic clone detection and functional similarity.   This paper demonstrates that BigCloneBench's Weakly Type-3/Type-4 (WT3/T4) subset is problematic as ground truth for learning or evaluating functional similarity. Its tagged-tagged WT3/T4 clone pairs combine two methods labelled as true positives for the same functionality and do not contain exemplar functions. A population-weighted analysis of a stratified probability sample of 406 such pairs estimated that 93.9% of pairs in the eligible tagged-tagged WT3/T4 population are not functionally similar under our operational definition and are therefore mislabelled (conservative 95% confidence interval: 91.5%-96.2%).   From a literature review of 179 papers, we estimate that 128 used BigCloneBench to evaluate semantic clone detection in a way that their results could

translated_title: 数据集的误用如何损害了语义克隆检测
translated_abstract: BigCloneBench被广泛用于评估传统的代码克隆检测，以及近年来用于评估语义克隆检测和功能相似性的机器学习方法。本文证明BigCloneBench的弱Type-3/Type-4（WT3/T4）子集作为学习或评估功能相似性的真实基准存在严重问题。其tagged-tagged的WT3/T4克隆对将两个被标记为针对相同功能的真阳性方法组合在一起，且不包含示例函数。通过对406对样本的分层概率抽样进行总体加权分析，我们估计在符合条件的tagged-tagged WT3/T4总体中，93.9%的克隆对在我们的操作性定义下功能并不相似，因此属于错误标注（保守95%置信区间：91.5%-96.2%）。通过对179篇论文的文献综述，我们估计有128篇论文使用BigCloneBench评估语义克隆检测的方式会使其结果受到影响。
tldr: BigCloneBench数据集的WT3/T4子集存在系统性标注错误（约93.9%的克隆对功能并不相似），导致128篇使用该数据集评估语义克隆检测的研究结果的可信度受到严重损害。
en_tdlr: The BigCloneBench WT3/T4 subset suffers from systematic mislabeling (93.9% of clone pairs are not functionally similar), undermining the validity of semantic clone detection evaluations in 128 studies that used this benchmark.
